from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyObservation(BaseModel):
    """A single month's construction data point extracted from a document table."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month covered by the data, in YYYY-MM format")
    permits_saar: float | None = Field(description="Total Building Permits Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate")
    starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Total Housing Starts Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of the report this data came from, for precedence resolution")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_observations: list[MonthlyObservation]
